{{< video videos/feature_showcase_a.mp4 >}}

{{< video videos/feature_showcase_b.mp4 >}}

Chapters with headings, badges and a callout: representation cuts, painted regions and
     transparency, a focus move onto the central helix, and then the deposited 1CFC NMR
     ensemble played as a second entity.

     ProteinMotion continues with a contact-guided morph into troponin C, hydrogen bonds, live
     distances and electrostatics; those chapters are marked in the script as comments.

After ProteinMotion's [`feature_showcase.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/feature_showcase.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/feature_showcase.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/feature_showcase.py"}
{{< include scripts/feature_showcase.py >}}
```
